references.text: Connects the introduction of the redemption plan (Boaz) with its fulfillment (the birth of Obed), which resolves Naomi's childlessness.
Highlights the transition from Boaz's identity as a kinsman to his action as a redeemer to restore Elimelech's inheritance.
Links Boaz's local actions in Ruth to his central role in the Messiah line in Chronicles.
Connects Boaz's role as a kinsman (2:1) with the legal fulfillment of purchasing the family property (4:9).
